title: NeuroMorph
description: Check SWC neuron reconstructions and measure their morphology and Sholl profile with NeuroM's definitions.

measure.title: Measure morphology
measure.description: Check and repair SWC reconstructions, then measure length, branching, path and radial distance, branch and Strahler order, bifurcation angles, surface area, volume and Sholl intersections of each.

reconstructions.description: One or more SWC neuron reconstructions

shollStep.description: Distance between Sholl spheres in µm

repair.description: Replace zero radii with the nearest positive radius and merge samples repeating their parent's position
